network.title: Network settings
network.webNotice: Requests from the web version go through the hosted relay, which cannot use a proxy or certificates from your machine. The desktop app sends requests directly and has these settings, and the command line takes them as flags.
network.chooseCA: Choose the CA certificate (PEM or DER)
network.chooseCertificate: Choose the certificate (PEM, PFX or P12)
network.certificatesNote: A certificate is a PEM file with its key file, a PEM file that holds both, or a PFX/P12 file. A client certificate is presented only to its host; use *.example.com to cover subdomains. Passphrases are kept in the system keychain, never in Gostman's data file or a collection.
network.collectionActive: Applied on top of the settings above. Its certificates are tried first.
network.collectionRestricted: Not applied until you trust this folder: a folder you did not create may not choose a proxy or make Gostman read files.
